ctx.x: But you never know. Maybe I did occasionally, due to the fact that, if I want to make it full, and I'd drop jump on four-four full force, everything. Sy Oliver and I used to have some -- quite frequently had some heated arguments about that four-four and two-four bit.

Sy, when the band was going out, why Sy contributed a lot to that Lurcefurt Lurcefurt band. When we were "going home" as we used to say, that means last chorus course-going out, close the door in their face, Sy would tell me for two beats. Now, when you riding out, you want to send them out, you know. And so we would have some heated arguments.
